statement: Linux uses common offset 37 bits 0-2 for speaker preamp, gated by valid_flag1 (common byte 1) bit 7. Its USB jack-detect path selects preamp value 2 when it routes to the internal speaker (see audio-dualsense-kernel-jack-detect-routing). Its microphone mute request uses power-save-control common offset 9 bit 4, gated by valid_flag1 bit 1; the separate mute-button LED at offset 8 is gated by valid_flag1 bit 0. SDL calls offsets 8 and 9 microphone light and audio-mute fields, but does not define Linux's preamp or power-save semantics. These are independent requests, not a PCM modification.

applicability.scope: Consumer semantics and partial naming agreement, not a physical switch/mute confirmation.
